text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even lacking in enthusiasm, Wonder
Acute's
abilities carry her through a
good race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It sure is nice having all these people
here
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How could I forget how incredible the
other dirt
racers are? They've all been
working so hard to
get here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco may not be here anymore, but perhaps it's because Falco's not here...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That I feel there's still work for me to do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I just had a thought, but I want
your
opinion on it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What if... I became a chronicler of dirt
races?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Falco may be incredible, but no
one can
run against her while she's
running abroad.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So I'm thinking that I ought to pass down
her
legend to the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I mean, someone's got to be around to
tell the
young'uns about her...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Like how her astounding beauty could
turn even a
fairytale princess green with
envy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I figure that's something I can do. Even if
I were
to, say...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Quit running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Wonder Acute has not
recovered her
enthusiasm. Instead...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's thinking of collecting all her
memories from
her time in dirt racing
and becoming a wizened
storyteller who
passes down stories of the good
old
days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But... even still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come again? Did you say the JBC
Classic?
choice_data_list: Next... let's go with the JBC Classic.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.
choice_data_list: I still need to gather more material for folk tales!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gives me a smile, but I
don't miss
that she doesn't actually
agree to run the race. At
this rate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like we'll even make it to
the fall
JBC Classic. This summer may be
our last hurrah.
